scientific_assessments.topic: Finite ionic scalar, units and complete gradient
evidence: A27/ionic-reference-oracle-001.json checks finite_energy, direct_energy_derivative_0.0001, qe_force_style and all energy/force/sign/unit/charge mutations
scientific_assessments.assessment: The implementation differentiates one explicit finite scalar using physical Cartesian bohr coordinates, cell columns, actual UPF valence charges, Ry e2=2, both signed reciprocal vectors and real/reciprocal/self/background energy terms. Force and positive gradient are kept distinct, with atom-major flattening and no centering or symmetry repair. The independent oracle compares literal ordered-pair energies, energy derivatives and a separately assembled Native-style force route; its recorded derivative residual at h=0.0001 is 9.20691300976273e-12 and its Native-style comparison residual is 6.661338147750939e-16. Actual material evidence reports all 111 force coordinates, energy -6800.408832280806 Ry, no coordinate outside the F14.8 half-step, maximum absolute printed-ion-ion discrepancy 4.085797478126096e-09 Ry/bohr, and real cutoff gap 0.23008688599800742 bohr. These are retained recorded results, not reviewer computations or an infinite-sum error certificate.
